protocols.title: Two protocols measure different things
protocols.caption: These protocols cannot be combined into a direct harmful-request refusal rate.

study-scope.title: 114 cases, 160 request attempts
study-scope.caption: The two retries and four follow-ups have input-history defects and are not clean comparisons.

benign-labels.title: Labels for 60 benign or authorized tasks
benign-labels.caption: Five clarification-only cases are excluded; labels have not received independent human review.

willingness-counts.title: 33 willingness probes, different stated choices
willingness-counts.caption: 19 decline, 4 accept, 10 clarify; AI-assisted classifications without independent human review.

history-defect.title: How archived history confounded later checks
history-defect.caption: Outputs and counts remain observations; retries and follow-ups do not isolate a causal effect.

protocols.title: 两种方法，测量两件事
protocols.caption: 两种协议不能合并计算原始越界请求的实际拒答率。

study-scope.title: 114 个案例，160 次请求
study-scope.caption: 两次重测和四次补测存在输入历史缺陷，不能当作干净对照。

benign-labels.title: 60 个正常或授权任务的标签
benign-labels.caption: 5 个专门要求澄清的单轮案例未计入这 60 个任务；标签无独立人工复核。

willingness-counts.title: 33 个表态题，各领域选择不同
willingness-counts.caption: 19 次拒绝、4 次接受、10 次澄清；分类由 AI 助手完成，未独立人工复核。

history-defect.title: 请求历史如何污染后续验证
history-defect.caption: 最终回答与计数仍保留；重测和补测不能支持单因素因果结论。
